summary: WorldEntity generation-5 still accepts unbounded retained kind/origin strings even though entity IDs, resolved-region keys, and persistent-state text are explicitly byte-bounded. A valid record can therefore retain arbitrarily large kind/worldId/regionId/generator/recipeKey strings, and duplicate diagnostics can retain large incoming kind/recipeKey strings again within the bounded diagnostic ring.
evidence: Reviewed active WorldEntity generation-5 head 83850e9f2bab4572de800428fb510b6b75fc2c45; its source hardening and numeric/no-execute regressions do not add retained descriptive/origin string ceilings
WorldEntity.isId() already rejects IDs over 256 bytes, while persistentState is bounded to 65536 cumulative string-key/value bytes plus depth/node limits

checkedNonEmpty() validates only primitive string type, non-empty content, and control-character absence; cloneOrigin() uses it for worldId, optional regionId, generator, and recipeKey, and ownRecord()/new() use it for kind

createRegistry() owns and stores the full record; duplicate identity diagnostics freeze existing/incoming kind and recipeKey values and retain up to duplicateDiagnosticCapacity entries (default 64), so the missing scalar ceilings are also a bounded-ring memory-amplification surface

ResolvedRegionRecipe already defines MAX_KEY_BYTES = 256 and enforces that bound on canonical worldId/regionId/semantic/reference keys, with worldId/regionId additionally checked as their StableId namespaces

Repository PR/issue searches found no existing WorldEntity overlong kind/origin-string repair lane; current PR #397 is focused on generation-4 hardening plus no-execute and numeric-ceiling regressions
recommendation: After the current WorldEntity generation-5 lineage settles, create one bounded source/test follow-up for retained scalar text limits. Reuse existing canonical 256-byte key/StableId limits where the field is an identity/key and define an explicit small project-owned ceiling for descriptive kind/generator text rather than allowing arbitrary strings. Add exact max/max+1 regressions through WorldEntity.new() and registry register(), preserve primitive type-first/no-execute ordering and existing accepted identity bytes, and verify duplicate diagnostics cannot retain an over-limit incoming kind/recipeKey. Treat stronger worldId/regionId StableId namespace enforcement as a separate compatibility decision if existing producers require migration. No Studio evidence is needed or claimed.
